info.longName: Xtrackers S&P Dividend Aristocrats Screened ETF

funds_data.description: The fund, using a “passive” or indexing investment approach, seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of constituents from the S&P High Yield Dividend Aristocrats Index that meet certain environmental, social and governance (“ESG”) criteria. It is non-diversified.
